notes: The supplied Luiss page for Business Administration is the closest page for this Bachelor-level programme; no page is specifically dedicated to Management and Artificial Intelligence. Duration (3 years, 180 ECTS, English) and the programme's bilingual name in the admission lists are the only facts evidenced for this Bachelor. The Italian-language admission pages for non-EU students (Ammissione con certificazioni, Extra-UE) mention Business Administration only as one of several degree courses and cover admissions generally: no deadline for a specific programme, no document list for this programme. No tuition for non-EU/international Bachelor students living abroad is stated for this programme; the € 15.000 'contributo unico' quotes appear in EU/Schengen admission pages and in the extra-UE page's FAQ, and the extra-UE page requires a Bando for the procedure, so tuition is left out. No application channel (Universitaly or a Luiss portal) for this programme is named in the pages supplied.

note.fr: Les pages ne donnent pas de critères d'admission détaillés (notes minimales, test, documents) : le Bando sera publié en octobre 2026. Vérifiez la procédure correspondant à votre profil (diplôme marocain, hors UE).
note.en: The pages give no detailed admission criteria (grade thresholds, test, documents): the Bando will be published in October 2026. Check the procedure matching your profile (Moroccan diploma, non-EU).

evidence.quote: The admission announcements, which include eligibility requirements, selection procedures, required documents, and application deadlines, will be published in October 2026.

note.en: No application deadline for 2027/2028 is given for this programme: the deadlines will be published in the admission announcement (Bando).
